propositions: Completion verification frequently fails with no verdict due to request-budget exhaustion, runaway duplicate tool-call loops, or token limits, leaving the gate unable to close deterministically
Current recovery architecture fans out one isolated LLM run per criterion (worst case 440 requests for 22 criteria × 20-request budget), causing context re-send overhead and resource waste
Recovery context bound is a flat 100,000 characters that rejects live tickets larger than 121,147 characters because ticket context is append-only and grows unbounded
Duplicate read-only tool calls within single agentic runs execute repeatedly instead of being memoized, inflating request counts and enabling runaway loops
Any completion verification run that banks at least one criterion verdict must finalize to a full-coverage verdict rather than die verdict-less, with a no-LLM fallback for runs with banked progress
